instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: The old man called out. I stood still for an hour while he sat listening. A small cry of fear came from his bed. At last, I let a thin line of lantern light fall across his eye. This time, his eye was wide open. Then I heard a low, fast beat, like a watch inside cotton. His heart was beating faster and louder. What if a neighbor heard it? I shouted and jumped forward, and he screamed once. I dragged him onto the floor and pulled the heavy bed over him. His heart kept beating for a little longer. At last, there was no sound. I hid his body under three wooden floorboards. I put them back carefully, leaving no mark.
